Self-Balancing Reaction Wheel Cube

6 inch weighted reaction wheel, 3d printed housing, gimbal motor and FOC control. The balance controller uses 3 nested PID loop.

Sense the orientation

A BNO085 inertial measurement unit measures the cube's orientation. Sensor filtering supports the feedback loop.

Control the reaction wheel

I simulated the reaction wheel in simulink and used realistic parameters to test control loop design and PID tuning. At t=5s, the simulation gives a kick to the cube to test its resiliency to disturbance.

Recover and explore

Motor speed regulation and automatic recovery behavior improve stability. Further exploration uses rapid acceleration and braking to investigate jumping and balance recovery.

Motivation

Satellites use reaction wheels in space to orient themselves and maintain stable pointing for optical instruments and communication. Good reaction wheel design allows for precise satellite pointing and reduced mechanical vibration.

My project is inspired by the Cubli project as well as many others who made similar balancing cubes on youtube. I simplified the project to a single DOF so that I could have a good baseline for balancing along a single axis.

Inside the design and control system

I designed and built the cube around an ESP32 microcontroller, BNO085 IMU, and GM4108H-120T Gimbal Motor with a built in encoder. The motor is controlled with the MKS ESP32 FOC board and powered by a 3s 300mah toothpick LiHV battery which gives plenty of runtime. Code is written mostly with GPT-5.5, control loop design and PID parameters chosen by me through repeated trial and error.

The controller uses 3 nested PID loops. The first loop uses the IMU to measure the position and rotational velocity relative to the set balance point.

The second loop allows the set balance point to be changed by up to 3 deg as the wheel speed increases. This loop attempts to prevent the wheelspeed from reaching saturation by throwing the balance point in the opposite direction and then bleeding off the extra wheel speed. This loop has to tradeoff between a low wheelspeed target and strong disturbance rejection.

The final control loop allows the maximum allowable balance point offset to be controllable. High max balance point offset allows large disturbance rejection but causes vibration during normal operation. Low max balance point offset allows smoother operation but low disturbance rejection. The third control loop allows the max balance point to go up if there is a large disturbance, and reduce as the disturbance is mitigated.

BalanceCube_Jump.ino
Arduino / C++
#include <SimpleFOC.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <SparkFun_BNO08x_Arduino_Library.h>

// ============================================================
// MOTOR + DRIVER
// ============================================================

BLDCMotor motor = BLDCMotor(11);

BLDCDriver3PWM driver(
  32,  // phase A
  33,  // phase B
  25,  // phase C
  22   // enable
);

// ============================================================
// AS5048A PWM ENCODER
// ============================================================

constexpr int ENCODER_PIN = 15;

// Measured PWM limits
MagneticSensorPWM sensor(ENCODER_PIN, 3, 921);

void encoderISR() {
  sensor.handlePWM();
}

// ============================================================
// BNO085 IMU
// ============================================================

TwoWire IMU_Wire = TwoWire(1);
BNO08x imu;

constexpr int IMU_SDA = 23;
constexpr int IMU_SCL = 5;
constexpr uint8_t IMU_ADDRESS = 0x4B;

// Requested report interval in milliseconds.
//
// 10 ms = 100 Hz
// 5 ms  = 200 Hz
// 4 ms  = 250 Hz
// 2 ms  = 500 Hz requested
//
// U command changes this over serial.
uint16_t imuIntervalMs = 5;

// ============================================================
// PID SETTINGS
// ============================================================

float balanceSetpointDeg = 42.5f;

// Kp = volts / degree
// Ki = volts / (degree * second)
// Kd = volts / (degree / second)

float Kp = 5.0f;
float Ki = 3.0f;
float Kd = 0.2f;

// ============================================================
// OUTER WHEEL-SPEED PID
//
// This slower loop moves the balance setpoint slightly so the
// cube leans in the direction that removes stored wheel speed.
// Its output is degrees, not motor voltage.
// ============================================================

float wheelSpeedSetpointRPM = 10.0f;

// Kp = degrees / RPM
// Ki = degrees / (RPM * second)
// Kd = degrees / (RPM / second)
float wheelKp = 0.01f;
float wheelKi = 0.01f;
float wheelKd = 0.000f;

// Maximum amount the outer loop may move the balance point.
// This is the quiet, normal-operation limit.
float maxBalanceOffsetDeg = 1.0f;

// Recovery authority grows from the normal limit to this value
// as absolute wheel-speed error rises from the start threshold
// to the full-recovery threshold.
float emergencyMaxBalanceOffsetDeg = 3.0f;
float recoveryStartErrorRPM = 15.0f;
float recoveryFullErrorRPM = 60.0f;

// Maximum rate at which the outer loop may move the balance
// point. This prevents a jerk when wheel speed changes sign.
// Set to 0 to disable the slew-rate limit.
float maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS = 5.0f;

// The slew rate also grows during recovery so the extra
// authority arrives quickly enough to catch the cube.
float emergencyBalanceOffsetRateDegS = 60.0f;

// Maximum integral contribution to the balance-point offset.
float wheelIntegralLimitDeg = 1.0f;

// Encoder-velocity low-pass filter. Smaller = smoother/slower.
float wheelSpeedFilterAlpha = 0.05f;

// Reverse with Q if wheel speed grows instead of settling.
float wheelLoopDirection = -1.0f;

// ============================================================
// VOLTAGE SETTINGS
// ============================================================

constexpr float SUPPLY_VOLTAGE = 15.0f;

// Maximum commanded q-axis voltage
float voltageLimit = 12.0f;

// Maximum voltage contribution from integral term
float integralVoltageLimit = 3.0f;

// ============================================================
// SAFETY / BALANCE SETTINGS
// ============================================================

// Stop driving after cube has clearly fallen
float maxAllowedAngleErrorDeg = 20.0f;

// Adjustable deadband
float deadbandDeg = 0.0f;

// Overall control direction
float motorDirection = -1.0f;

// Gyro direction
float gyroDirection = 1.0f;

// ============================================================
// GYRO FILTER
// ============================================================

// 1.0 = no additional filtering
// smaller = more smoothing, but more delay
float gyroFilterAlpha = 1.0f;

// ============================================================
// STATE
// ============================================================

float pitchDeg = 0.0f;

float rawGyroDegS = 0.0f;
float filteredGyroDegS = 0.0f;

float integralError = 0.0f;

float filteredWheelSpeedRPM = 0.0f;
float previousWheelSpeedError = 0.0f;
float wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;

float wheelPTerm = 0.0f;
float wheelITerm = 0.0f;
float wheelDTerm = 0.0f;
float balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
float effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = 42.5f;
float recoveryFactor = 0.0f;
float activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg = 1.0f;
float activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS = 5.0f;

bool pitchValid = false;
bool gyroValid = false;

bool loggingEnabled = false;

// The cube now has a physical power switch, so enable balancing

// ============================================================
// JUMP-UP SETTINGS + STATE
// ============================================================

// Send JUMP to:
//   1. Ramp the wheel drive to full voltage.
//   2. Hold full voltage until 320 RPM in the pre-spin direction.
//   3. Apply full voltage until 320 RPM in the opposite direction.
//   4. Hand off to the balance PID inside the capture window.
//
// JUMP+ and JUMP- force the kick direction. X aborts immediately.
constexpr float JUMP_TARGET_RPM = 320.0f;
constexpr uint32_t JUMP_RAMP_MS = 1200;
constexpr uint32_t JUMP_SPIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;
constexpr uint32_t JUMP_REVERSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;
constexpr uint32_t JUMP_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS = 1500;
constexpr float JUMP_CAPTURE_ANGLE_DEG = 15.0f;

enum JumpState {
  JUMP_IDLE,
  JUMP_RAMP,
  JUMP_SPIN,
  JUMP_REVERSE,
  JUMP_CAPTURE
};

JumpState jumpState = JUMP_IDLE;
uint32_t jumpPhaseStartMs = 0;

// Sign of the voltage used for the kick toward upright.
// The pre-spin direction is the opposite of this sign.
float jumpKickSign = 1.0f;

void startJump(float requestedKickSign);
void finishJump(bool captured);
void runJump();

// Goes true whenever a fresh gyro packet arrives
bool newControlSample = false;

uint32_t previousControlMicros = 0;

// Latest PID terms for logging
float pTerm = 0.0f;
float iTerm = 0.0f;
float dTerm = 0.0f;

float lastRawAngleError = 0.0f;
float lastControlAngleError = 0.0f;

// ============================================================
// STOP CONTROLLER
// ============================================================

void stopController(bool printMessage) {

  controllerEnabled = false;
  jumpState = JUMP_IDLE;

  integralError = 0.0f;
  wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
  previousWheelSpeedError = 0.0f;
  balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
  effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = balanceSetpointDeg;
  recoveryFactor = 0.0f;
  activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg = maxBalanceOffsetDeg;
  activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS = maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS;

  wheelPTerm = 0.0f;
  wheelITerm = 0.0f;
  wheelDTerm = 0.0f;

  pTerm = 0.0f;
  iTerm = 0.0f;
  dTerm = 0.0f;

  motor.target = 0.0f;

  if (printMessage) {
    Serial.println("Controller DISABLED");
  }
}

// ============================================================
// JUMP-UP SEQUENCE
// ============================================================

void startJump(float requestedKickSign) {

  if (jumpState != JUMP_IDLE) {
    Serial.println("Jump already active; send X to abort.");
    return;
  }

  if (!pitchValid || !gyroValid) {
    Serial.println("Jump refused: waiting for valid IMU data.");
    return;
  }

  float rawAngleError =
    pitchDeg -
    balanceSetpointDeg;

  // JUMP is a deliberate manual command. Do not reject it based on
  // pitch: either resting side is only about 42.5 or 47.5 degrees
  // from the 42.5-degree balance point, and IMU angle wrapping can
  // make a fixed side-angle test unreliable.
  Serial.print("JUMP: pitch/error = ");
  Serial.print(pitchDeg, 2);
  Serial.print(" / ");
  Serial.println(rawAngleError, 2);

  controllerEnabled = false;
  integralError = 0.0f;
  wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
  previousWheelSpeedError = 0.0f;
  balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
  effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = balanceSetpointDeg;
  recoveryFactor = 0.0f;
  activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg = maxBalanceOffsetDeg;
  activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS = maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS;

  if (requestedKickSign > 0.0f) {
    jumpKickSign = 1.0f;
  }
  else if (requestedKickSign < 0.0f) {
    jumpKickSign = -1.0f;
  }
  else {
    // Select the voltage direction that the proven balance PID
    // would use to correct the cube from its present side.
    jumpKickSign =
      (motorDirection * rawAngleError >= 0.0f) ?
      1.0f : -1.0f;
  }

  motor.target = 0.0f;
  jumpPhaseStartMs = millis();
  jumpState = JUMP_RAMP;

  Serial.print("JUMP START: kick direction = ");
  Serial.println(jumpKickSign, 0);
  Serial.println("Send X to abort.");
}

void finishJump(bool captured) {

  jumpState = JUMP_IDLE;
  motor.target = 0.0f;
  integralError = 0.0f;
  wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
  balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
  effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = balanceSetpointDeg;

  if (captured) {
    filteredGyroDegS = rawGyroDegS;
    filteredWheelSpeedRPM =
      motor.shaft_velocity * 60.0f / (2.0f * PI);
    previousWheelSpeedError =
      wheelSpeedSetpointRPM - filteredWheelSpeedRPM;
    previousControlMicros = micros();
    controllerEnabled = true;
    Serial.println("JUMP CAPTURED: balance controller enabled.");
  }
  else {
    controllerEnabled = false;
    Serial.println("JUMP ENDED: capture failed; motor stopped.");
  }
}

void runJump() {

  if (jumpState == JUMP_IDLE) {
    return;
  }

  uint32_t elapsedMs =
    millis() -
    jumpPhaseStartMs;

  float rawAngleError =
    pitchDeg -
    balanceSetpointDeg;

  // Transfer to the working balance controller immediately once
  // the reverse kick brings the cube into the capture window.
  if (
    (jumpState == JUMP_REVERSE || jumpState == JUMP_CAPTURE) &&
    fabs(rawAngleError) <= JUMP_CAPTURE_ANGLE_DEG
  ) {
    finishJump(true);
    return;
  }

  switch (jumpState) {

    case JUMP_RAMP: {

      float rampFraction =
        constrain(
          elapsedMs / (float)JUMP_RAMP_MS,
          0.0f,
          1.0f
        );

      // Pre-spin opposite the direction of the upcoming kick.
      motor.target =
        -jumpKickSign *
        voltageLimit *
        rampFraction;

      if (elapsedMs >= JUMP_RAMP_MS) {
        jumpState = JUMP_SPIN;
        jumpPhaseStartMs = millis();
        Serial.println("JUMP: full-voltage spin-up.");
      }

      break;
    }

    case JUMP_SPIN: {

      motor.target =
        -jumpKickSign *
        voltageLimit;

      float wheelRPM =
        fabs(motor.shaft_velocity) *
        60.0f /
        (2.0f * PI);

      if (
        wheelRPM >= JUMP_TARGET_RPM ||
        elapsedMs >= JUMP_SPIN_TIMEOUT_MS
      ) {
        if (wheelRPM >= JUMP_TARGET_RPM) {
          Serial.print("JUMP: target reached at ");
        }
        else {
          Serial.print("JUMP: spin timeout at ");
        }

        Serial.print(wheelRPM, 0);
        Serial.println(" RPM; applying full reverse.");

        jumpState = JUMP_REVERSE;
        jumpPhaseStartMs = millis();
      }

      break;
    }

    case JUMP_REVERSE: {

      // Drive all the way through zero to the target speed in the
      // opposite direction. This gives the wheel its maximum possible
      // momentum change before the balance controller takes over.
      motor.target =
        jumpKickSign *
        voltageLimit;

      float signedWheelRPM =
        motor.shaft_velocity *
        60.0f /
        (2.0f * PI);

      bool reverseTargetReached =
        jumpKickSign * signedWheelRPM >=
        JUMP_TARGET_RPM;

      if (
        reverseTargetReached ||
        elapsedMs >= JUMP_REVERSE_TIMEOUT_MS
      ) {
        motor.target = 0.0f;
        jumpState = JUMP_CAPTURE;
        jumpPhaseStartMs = millis();

        if (reverseTargetReached) {
          Serial.println("JUMP: full reverse RPM reached; waiting for capture.");
        }
        else {
          Serial.println("JUMP: reverse timeout; waiting for capture.");
        }
      }

      break;
    }

    case JUMP_CAPTURE:

      motor.target = 0.0f;

      if (elapsedMs >= JUMP_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        finishJump(false);
      }

      break;

    default:

      finishJump(false);
      break;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ENABLE IMU REPORTS
// ============================================================

bool enableIMUReports() {

  // Same requested update rate for orientation and gyro
  bool rotationOK =
    imu.enableRotationVector(imuIntervalMs);

  bool gyroOK =
    imu.enableGyro(imuIntervalMs);

  return rotationOK && gyroOK;
}

// ============================================================
// UPDATE IMU RATE
// ============================================================

void setIMURate(uint16_t intervalMs) {

  // Avoid requesting an interval of zero
  if (intervalMs < 1) {
    intervalMs = 1;
  }

  // Disable controller during reconfiguration
  bool wasEnabled = controllerEnabled;

  motor.target = 0.0f;
  controllerEnabled = false;

  imuIntervalMs = intervalMs;

  if (enableIMUReports()) {

    Serial.print("IMU interval = ");
    Serial.print(imuIntervalMs);
    Serial.println(" ms");

    Serial.print("Requested rate = ");
    Serial.print(1000.0f / imuIntervalMs, 1);
    Serial.println(" Hz");

  } else {

    Serial.println("ERROR: Could not update IMU reports.");
  }

  filteredGyroDegS = 0.0f;
  integralError = 0.0f;
  wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
  balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
  effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = balanceSetpointDeg;

  previousControlMicros = micros();

  if (wasEnabled && AUTO_START_CONTROLLER) {

    controllerEnabled = true;

    Serial.println(
      "Controller automatically re-enabled after IMU rate change."
    );

  }

  else if (wasEnabled) {

    Serial.println(
      "Controller remains disabled after IMU rate change."
    );

    Serial.println(
      "Send A to enable again."
    );
  }
}

// ============================================================
// SERIAL COMMAND HANDLING
// ============================================================

void processSerial() {

  if (!Serial.available()) {
    return;
  }

  String input = Serial.readStringUntil('\n');
  input.trim();

  if (input.length() == 0) {
    return;
  }

  // J already controls the wheel integral limit, so jump uses
  // complete-word commands that are handled before letter parsing.
  if (input.equalsIgnoreCase("JUMP")) {
    startJump(0.0f);
    return;
  }

  if (input.equalsIgnoreCase("JUMP+")) {
    startJump(1.0f);
    return;
  }

  if (input.equalsIgnoreCase("JUMP-")) {
    startJump(-1.0f);
    return;
  }

  char command = toupper(input.charAt(0));

  float value = 0.0f;

  if (input.length() > 1) {
    value = input.substring(1).toFloat();
  }

  switch (command) {

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // ENABLE
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'A':

      jumpState = JUMP_IDLE;
      motor.target = 0.0f;

      integralError = 0.0f;
      wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;

      filteredWheelSpeedRPM =
        motor.shaft_velocity * 60.0f / (2.0f * PI);

      previousWheelSpeedError =
        wheelSpeedSetpointRPM - filteredWheelSpeedRPM;

      filteredGyroDegS = rawGyroDegS;

      previousControlMicros = micros();

      controllerEnabled = true;

      Serial.println("Controller ENABLED");

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // DISABLE
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'X':

      stopController(true);

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // KP
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'P':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 10.0f) {

        Kp = value;

        Serial.print("Kp = ");
        Serial.println(Kp, 6);

      } else {

        Serial.println("Use P between 0 and 10.");
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // KI
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'I':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 10.0f) {

        Ki = value;

        integralError = 0.0f;

        Serial.print("Ki = ");
        Serial.println(Ki, 6);

      } else {

        Serial.println("Use I between 0 and 10.");
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // KD
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'D':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 1.0f) {

        Kd = value;

        Serial.print("Kd = ");
        Serial.println(Kd, 6);

      } else {

        Serial.println("Use D between 0 and 1.");
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // OUTER WHEEL-SPEED PID
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'S':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 1.0f) {
        wheelKp = value;
        Serial.print("Wheel Kp = ");
        Serial.println(wheelKp, 6);
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use S between 0 and 1.");
      }
      break;

    case 'T':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 1.0f) {
        wheelKi = value;
        wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
        Serial.print("Wheel Ki = ");
        Serial.println(wheelKi, 6);
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use T between 0 and 1.");
      }
      break;

    case 'Y':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 1.0f) {
        wheelKd = value;
        Serial.print("Wheel Kd = ");
        Serial.println(wheelKd, 6);
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use Y between 0 and 1.");
      }
      break;

    case 'C':

      if (value >= -10000.0f && value <= 10000.0f) {
        wheelSpeedSetpointRPM = value;
        wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
        Serial.print("Wheel target = ");
        Serial.print(wheelSpeedSetpointRPM, 2);
        Serial.println(" RPM");
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use C between -10000 and 10000 RPM.");
      }
      break;

    case 'M':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= emergencyMaxBalanceOffsetDeg) {
        maxBalanceOffsetDeg = value;
        wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
        Serial.print("Max balance offset = ");
        Serial.print(maxBalanceOffsetDeg, 3);
        Serial.println(" deg");
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use M between 0 and the emergency maximum.");
      }
      break;

    case 'K':

      if (value >= maxBalanceOffsetDeg && value <= 10.0f) {
        emergencyMaxBalanceOffsetDeg = value;
        Serial.print("Emergency max balance offset = ");
        Serial.print(emergencyMaxBalanceOffsetDeg, 3);
        Serial.println(" deg");
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use K between normal M and 10 degrees.");
      }
      break;

    case 'W':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 100.0f) {
        maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS = value;
        Serial.print("Max balance offset rate = ");
        Serial.print(maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS, 3);
        Serial.println(" deg/s");
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use W between 0 and 100 deg/s.");
      }
      break;

    case 'J':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 10.0f) {
        wheelIntegralLimitDeg = value;
        wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
        Serial.print("Wheel integral limit = ");
        Serial.print(wheelIntegralLimitDeg, 3);
        Serial.println(" deg");
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use J between 0 and 10 degrees.");
      }
      break;

    case 'O':

      if (value > 0.0f && value <= 1.0f) {
        wheelSpeedFilterAlpha = value;
        Serial.print("Wheel filter alpha = ");
        Serial.println(wheelSpeedFilterAlpha, 3);
      } else {
        Serial.println("Use O > 0 and <= 1.");
      }
      break;

    case 'Q':

      wheelLoopDirection *= -1.0f;
      wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
      Serial.print("Wheel-loop direction = ");
      Serial.println(wheelLoopDirection, 0);
      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // BALANCE POINT
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'B':

      balanceSetpointDeg = value;

      integralError = 0.0f;
      wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
      balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
      effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = balanceSetpointDeg;

      Serial.print("Balance setpoint = ");
      Serial.println(balanceSetpointDeg, 3);

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // DEADBAND
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'H':

      if (value >= 0.0f && value <= 5.0f) {

        deadbandDeg = value;

        integralError = 0.0f;

        Serial.print("Deadband = ");
        Serial.print(deadbandDeg, 3);
        Serial.println(" deg");

      } else {

        Serial.println(
          "Use H between 0 and 5 degrees."
        );
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // VOLTAGE LIMIT
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'V':

      if (
        value > 0.0f &&
        value <= SUPPLY_VOLTAGE
      ) {

        voltageLimit = value;

        driver.voltage_limit = voltageLimit;
        motor.voltage_limit = voltageLimit;

        Serial.print("Voltage limit = ");
        Serial.print(voltageLimit, 2);
        Serial.println(" V");

      } else {

        Serial.println(
          "Use V greater than 0 and <= 15."
        );
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // INTEGRAL LIMIT
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'N':

      if (
        value >= 0.0f &&
        value <= SUPPLY_VOLTAGE
      ) {

        integralVoltageLimit = value;

        integralError = 0.0f;

        Serial.print(
          "Integral voltage limit = "
        );

        Serial.print(
          integralVoltageLimit,
          2
        );

        Serial.println(" V");

      } else {

        Serial.println(
          "Use N between 0 and 15."
        );
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // GYRO FILTER
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'F':

      if (
        value > 0.0f &&
        value <= 1.0f
      ) {

        gyroFilterAlpha = value;

        Serial.print(
          "Gyro filter alpha = "
        );

        Serial.println(
          gyroFilterAlpha,
          3
        );

      } else {

        Serial.println(
          "Use F > 0 and <= 1."
        );
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // FALL CUTOFF
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'E':

      if (
        value > 0.0f &&
        value <= 90.0f
      ) {

        maxAllowedAngleErrorDeg = value;

        Serial.print("Fall cutoff = ");

        Serial.print(
          maxAllowedAngleErrorDeg,
          2
        );

        Serial.println(" deg");

      } else {

        Serial.println(
          "Use E between 0 and 90 degrees."
        );
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // IMU UPDATE INTERVAL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'U':

      if (
        value >= 1.0f &&
        value <= 100.0f
      ) {

        setIMURate(
          (uint16_t)value
        );

      } else {

        Serial.println(
          "Use U between 1 and 100 ms."
        );
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // MOTOR DIRECTION
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'R':

      motorDirection *= -1.0f;

      integralError = 0.0f;

      Serial.print("Motor direction = ");
      Serial.println(motorDirection, 0);

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // GYRO DIRECTION
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'G':

      gyroDirection *= -1.0f;

      filteredGyroDegS = 0.0f;

      Serial.print("Gyro direction = ");
      Serial.println(gyroDirection, 0);

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CLEAR INTEGRAL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'Z':

      integralError = 0.0f;
      wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;

      Serial.println("Both integrals cleared");

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // LOGGING
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 'L':

      loggingEnabled =
        !loggingEnabled;

      if (loggingEnabled) {

        Serial.println(
          "Logging ON"
        );

        Serial.println(
          "ms,rawError,error,gyro,wheelRPM,recoveryFactor,activeM,activeW,balanceOffset,effectiveSetpoint,P,I,D,target"
        );

      } else {

        Serial.println(
          "Logging OFF"
        );
      }

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // SETTINGS
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case '?':

      printSettings();

      break;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // UNKNOWN
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    default:

      Serial.println(
        "Unknown command."
      );

      printCommands();

      break;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// UPDATE IMU
// ============================================================

void updateIMU() {

  newControlSample = false;

  while (imu.getSensorEvent()) {

    uint8_t reportID =
      imu.getSensorEventID();

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // ROTATION VECTOR
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      reportID ==
      SENSOR_REPORTID_ROTATION_VECTOR
    ) {

      pitchDeg =
        imu.getPitch() *
        180.0f /
        PI;

      pitchValid = true;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // GYROSCOPE
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    else if (
      reportID ==
      SENSOR_REPORTID_GYROSCOPE_CALIBRATED
    ) {

      rawGyroDegS =
        gyroDirection *
        imu.getGyroY() *
        180.0f /
        PI;

      filteredGyroDegS +=
        gyroFilterAlpha *
        (
          rawGyroDegS -
          filteredGyroDegS
        );

      gyroValid = true;

      // New gyro packet = new control update
      newControlSample = true;
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // IMU RESET HANDLING
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (imu.wasReset()) {

    pitchValid = false;
    gyroValid = false;

    rawGyroDegS = 0.0f;
    filteredGyroDegS = 0.0f;

    integralError = 0.0f;
    wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;

    stopController(false);

    delay(10);

    if (!enableIMUReports()) {

      Serial.println(
        "ERROR re-enabling IMU after reset."
      );

    } else {

      Serial.println(
        "IMU reset detected."
      );

      if (AUTO_START_CONTROLLER) {
        previousControlMicros = micros();
        controllerEnabled = true;
        Serial.println(
          "Controller automatically re-enabled; waiting for IMU data."
        );
      } else {
        Serial.println(
          "Controller disabled; send A."
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// CONTROLLER
// ============================================================

void runController() {

  uint32_t nowMicros =
    micros();

  float dt =
    (
      nowMicros -
      previousControlMicros
    ) *
    1.0e-6f;

  previousControlMicros =
    nowMicros;

  // Expected dt at 200 Hz is ~0.005 seconds.
  // Ignore obviously invalid values.
  if (
    dt <= 0.0f ||
    dt > 0.05f
  ) {

    dt =
      imuIntervalMs *
      0.001f;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // OUTER WHEEL-SPEED PID
  // ==========================================================

  float rawWheelSpeedRPM =
    motor.shaft_velocity * 60.0f / (2.0f * PI);

  filteredWheelSpeedRPM +=
    wheelSpeedFilterAlpha *
    (rawWheelSpeedRPM - filteredWheelSpeedRPM);

  float wheelSpeedError =
    wheelSpeedSetpointRPM - filteredWheelSpeedRPM;

  wheelPTerm = wheelKp * wheelSpeedError;

  float wheelSpeedErrorRate =
    (wheelSpeedError - previousWheelSpeedError) / dt;

  previousWheelSpeedError = wheelSpeedError;
  wheelDTerm = wheelKd * wheelSpeedErrorRate;

  if (controllerEnabled && pitchValid && gyroValid && wheelKi > 0.0f) {
    wheelIntegralError += wheelSpeedError * dt;

    float maxWheelIntegralError =
      wheelIntegralLimitDeg / wheelKi;

    wheelIntegralError = constrain(
      wheelIntegralError,
      -maxWheelIntegralError,
      maxWheelIntegralError
    );
  } else if (wheelKi <= 0.0f) {
    wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
  }

  wheelITerm = wheelKi * wheelIntegralError;

  // ==========================================================
  // ADAPTIVE RECOVERY AUTHORITY
  //
  // Normal balancing keeps the small M and W values. If wheel
  // speed runs away, both authority and slew rate increase
  // smoothly. They automatically return as speed is bled off.
  // ==========================================================

  float absoluteWheelSpeedErrorRPM = fabs(wheelSpeedError);

  recoveryFactor = constrain(
    (absoluteWheelSpeedErrorRPM - recoveryStartErrorRPM) /
    (recoveryFullErrorRPM - recoveryStartErrorRPM),
    0.0f,
    1.0f
  );

  activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg =
    maxBalanceOffsetDeg +
    recoveryFactor *
    (emergencyMaxBalanceOffsetDeg - maxBalanceOffsetDeg);

  if (maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS > 0.0f) {
    activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS =
      maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS +
      recoveryFactor *
      (emergencyBalanceOffsetRateDegS - maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS);
  } else {
    activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS = 0.0f;
  }

  float requestedBalanceOffsetDeg = constrain(
    wheelLoopDirection * (wheelPTerm + wheelITerm + wheelDTerm),
    -activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg,
    activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg
  );

  if (activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS > 0.0f) {
    float maxOffsetStepDeg = activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS * dt;

    balanceOffsetDeg += constrain(
      requestedBalanceOffsetDeg - balanceOffsetDeg,
      -maxOffsetStepDeg,
      maxOffsetStepDeg
    );
  } else {
    balanceOffsetDeg = requestedBalanceOffsetDeg;
  }

  effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg =
    balanceSetpointDeg + balanceOffsetDeg;

  // ==========================================================
  // INNER ANGLE PID ERROR
  // ==========================================================

  float rawAngleError =
    pitchDeg -
    effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg;

  float angleError =
    rawAngleError;

  lastRawAngleError =
    rawAngleError;

  // ==========================================================
  // SOFT DEADBAND
  // ==========================================================

  if (
    fabs(angleError) <=
    deadbandDeg
  ) {

    angleError = 0.0f;

  } else {

    angleError -=
      copysign(
        deadbandDeg,
        angleError
      );
  }

  lastControlAngleError =
    angleError;

  // ==========================================================
  // DEFAULT PID VALUES
  // ==========================================================

  pTerm = 0.0f;
  iTerm = 0.0f;
  dTerm = 0.0f;

  // ==========================================================
  // CONTROLLER DISABLED
  // ==========================================================

  if (
    !controllerEnabled ||
    !pitchValid ||
    !gyroValid
  ) {

    integralError = 0.0f;
    wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
    balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
    effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = balanceSetpointDeg;
    recoveryFactor = 0.0f;
    activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg = maxBalanceOffsetDeg;
    activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS = maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS;

    motor.target = 0.0f;

    return;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // FALL CUTOFF
  // ==========================================================

  if (
    fabs(rawAngleError) >
    maxAllowedAngleErrorDeg
  ) {

    integralError = 0.0f;
    wheelIntegralError = 0.0f;
    balanceOffsetDeg = 0.0f;
    effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg = balanceSetpointDeg;
    recoveryFactor = 0.0f;
    activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg = maxBalanceOffsetDeg;
    activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS = maxBalanceOffsetRateDegS;

    motor.target = 0.0f;

    return;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // PROPORTIONAL
  // ==========================================================

  pTerm =
    Kp *
    angleError;

  // ==========================================================
  // DERIVATIVE
  //
  // We use gyro directly instead of differentiating angle.
  // This is much less noisy.
  // ==========================================================

  dTerm =
    -Kd *
    filteredGyroDegS;

  // ==========================================================
  // INTEGRAL
  // ==========================================================

  float pdVoltage =
    motorDirection *
    (
      pTerm +
      dTerm
    );

  if (
    Ki > 0.0f &&
    angleError != 0.0f &&
    fabs(pdVoltage) <
    voltageLimit
  ) {

    integralError +=
      angleError *
      dt;

    float maxIntegralError =
      integralVoltageLimit /
      Ki;

    integralError =
      constrain(
        integralError,
        -maxIntegralError,
        maxIntegralError
      );
  }

  else if (
    Ki <= 0.0f
  ) {

    integralError = 0.0f;
  }

  iTerm =
    Ki *
    integralError;

  // ==========================================================
  // TOTAL CONTROL VOLTAGE
  // ==========================================================

  float controlVoltage =
    motorDirection *
    (
      pTerm +
      iTerm +
      dTerm
    );

  // ==========================================================
  // OUTPUT LIMIT
  // ==========================================================

  motor.target =
    constrain(
      controlVoltage,
      -voltageLimit,
      voltageLimit
    );
}

// ============================================================
// SETUP
// ============================================================

void setup() {

  Serial.begin(115200);

  Serial.setTimeout(10);

  delay(1000);

  Serial.println();
  Serial.println(
    "Starting high-rate reaction-wheel PID..."
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // IMU I2C
  // ==========================================================

  IMU_Wire.begin(
    IMU_SDA,
    IMU_SCL,
    400000
  );

  if (
    !imu.begin(
      IMU_ADDRESS,
      IMU_Wire
    )
  ) {

    Serial.println(
      "ERROR: BNO085 not found at 0x4B."
    );

    while (true) {
      delay(1000);
    }
  }

  if (
    !enableIMUReports()
  ) {

    Serial.println(
      "ERROR: Could not enable IMU reports."
    );

    while (true) {
      delay(1000);
    }
  }

  Serial.println(
    "BNO085 ready."
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // ENCODER
  // ==========================================================

  sensor.init();

  sensor.enableInterrupt(
    encoderISR
  );

  motor.linkSensor(
    &sensor
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // DRIVER
  // ==========================================================

  driver.voltage_power_supply =
    SUPPLY_VOLTAGE;

  driver.voltage_limit =
    voltageLimit;

  if (!driver.init()) {

    Serial.println(
      "ERROR: Driver init failed."
    );

    while (true) {
      delay(1000);
    }
  }

  motor.linkDriver(
    &driver
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // SIMPLEFOC
  // ==========================================================

  motor.foc_modulation =
    FOCModulationType::SpaceVectorPWM;

  motor.controller =
    MotionControlType::torque;

  motor.torque_controller =
    TorqueControlType::voltage;

  motor.voltage_limit =
    voltageLimit;

  motor.target =
    0.0f;

  motor.init();

  motor.initFOC();

  previousControlMicros =
    micros();

  controllerEnabled = AUTO_START_CONTROLLER;

  Serial.println(
    "Motor ready."
  );

  if (AUTO_START_CONTROLLER) {
    Serial.println(
      "Controller automatically enabled; waiting for IMU data."
    );
  }

  printCommands();

  printSettings();
}

// ============================================================
// MAIN LOOP
// ============================================================

void loop() {

  // ==========================================================
  // RUN FOC AS FAST AS POSSIBLE
  // ==========================================================

  motor.loopFOC();

  // ==========================================================
  // READ ALL AVAILABLE IMU PACKETS
  // ==========================================================

  updateIMU();

  // ==========================================================
  // UPDATE PID ONLY WHEN NEW GYRO DATA ARRIVES
  // ==========================================================

  if (jumpState != JUMP_IDLE) {

    runJump();
  }

  else if (newControlSample) {

    runController();
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // APPLY MOST RECENT TORQUE COMMAND
  // ==========================================================

  motor.move();

  // ==========================================================
  // SERIAL
  // ==========================================================

  processSerial();

  // ==========================================================
  // LOGGING
  // ==========================================================

  if (loggingEnabled) {

    static uint32_t lastLogMicros = 0;

    uint32_t nowMicros =
      micros();

    // 100 Hz logging.
    // Keep this slower than the control loop.
    if (
      nowMicros -
      lastLogMicros >=
      10000
    ) {

      lastLogMicros =
        nowMicros;

      Serial.print(
        millis()
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        lastRawAngleError,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        lastControlAngleError,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        filteredGyroDegS,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        filteredWheelSpeedRPM,
        2
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        recoveryFactor,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        activeBalanceOffsetLimitDeg,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        activeBalanceOffsetRateDegS,
        2
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        balanceOffsetDeg,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        effectiveBalanceSetpointDeg,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        pTerm,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        iTerm,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.print(
        dTerm,
        3
      );

      Serial.print(',');

      Serial.println(
        motor.target,
        3
      );
    }
  }
}

Matlab Sim

animate_reaction_wheel_box.m
MATLAB
% animate_reaction_wheel_box.m
% Front-view animation of reaction-wheel cube
%
% theta = 0 means cube balanced upright on its corner

%% ============================================================
% GET SIMULATION DATA
% =============================================================

% This model also calls this script from StopFcn. That callback runs
% before simulation results are returned to the calling workspace.
% Do not start another simulation or animate stale data from a callback.
if bdIsLoaded('reaction_wheel_box') && ...
        ~strcmp(get_param('reaction_wheel_box', 'SimulationStatus'), 'stopped')
    fprintf(['Animation deferred until simulation results are available. ' ...
        'Run animate_reaction_wheel_box after the simulation returns.\n']);
    return;
end

% Support direct workspace variables or Single Simulation Output.
% Building/opening the model does not produce simulation results.
hasDirectResults = exist('theta_out','var') && ...
    exist('wheel_speed_out','var');
hasOutputResults = false;
if exist('out','var') && isa(out, 'Simulink.SimulationOutput')
    outputNames = who(out);
    hasOutputResults = all(ismember( ...
        {'theta_out', 'wheel_speed_out'}, outputNames));
elseif exist('out','var') && isstruct(out)
    hasOutputResults = isfield(out, 'theta_out') && ...
        isfield(out, 'wheel_speed_out');
end

if ~hasDirectResults && ~hasOutputResults
    modelFile = fullfile(fileparts(mfilename('fullpath')), ...
        'reaction_wheel_box.slx');
    if ~isfile(modelFile)
        error('ReactionWheel:MissingResults', ...
            ['No theta_out/wheel_speed_out results or model file found. ' ...
             'Run the Simulink model first, then run this animation.']);
    end
    fprintf('No complete animation results found. Running reaction_wheel_box...\n');
    load_system(modelFile);
    out = sim('reaction_wheel_box', 'ReturnWorkspaceOutputs', 'on');
    outputNames = who(out);
    if ~all(ismember({'theta_out', 'wheel_speed_out'}, outputNames))
        error('ReactionWheel:MissingLoggedSignals', ...
            ['The simulation did not return theta_out and wheel_speed_out. ' ...
             'Check the To Workspace block variable names and connections.']);
    end
    hasOutputResults = true;
end

% Use both signals from the same source, rather than mixing old workspace
% variables with a different simulation output.
if hasOutputResults
    thetaData = out.theta_out;
    wheelData = out.wheel_speed_out;
else
    thetaData = theta_out;
    wheelData = wheel_speed_out;
end

if ~isa(thetaData, 'timeseries') || ~isa(wheelData, 'timeseries')
    error('ReactionWheel:InvalidLogFormat', ...
        ['theta_out and wheel_speed_out must be timeseries. ' ...
         'Set both To Workspace blocks to Timeseries and rerun the model.']);
end

%% Extract data

t = thetaData.Time;
theta = thetaData.Data;

tw = wheelData.Time;
wheel_speed = wheelData.Data;

t = t(:);
theta = theta(:);

tw = tw(:);
wheel_speed = wheel_speed(:);

if numel(t) < 2 || numel(tw) < 2 || ...
        numel(theta) ~= numel(t) || numel(wheel_speed) ~= numel(tw)
    error('ReactionWheel:InvalidSamples', ...
        'Each logged signal must be scalar with at least two time samples.');
end
if any(~isfinite(t)) || any(~isfinite(tw)) || ...
        any(~isfinite(theta)) || any(~isfinite(wheel_speed)) || ...
        any(diff(t) <= 0) || any(diff(tw) <= 0)
    error('ReactionWheel:InvalidSamples', ...
        'Logged values must be finite and timestamps must strictly increase.');
end

%% Match wheel speed timestamps to theta timestamps

if length(tw) ~= length(t) || any(tw ~= t)

    wheel_speed = interp1( ...
        tw, ...
        wheel_speed, ...
        t, ...
        'linear', ...
        'extrap');

end


%% ============================================================
% ANIMATION SETTINGS
% =============================================================

fps = 30;

% Set exportVideo = false in the workspace to preview without recording.
% Override videoFile to choose another destination before running this script.
if ~exist('exportVideo', 'var')
    exportVideo = true;
end
if ~exist('videoFile', 'var')
    videoFile = fullfile(fileparts(mfilename('fullpath')), ...
        'reaction_wheel_simulation.mp4');
end

% Generate animation timestamps
t_anim = (t(1):1/fps:t(end))';

% Interpolate simulation data
theta_anim = interp1(t, theta, t_anim);

wheel_speed_anim = interp1( ...
    t, ...
    wheel_speed, ...
    t_anim);


%% Calculate wheel angle

% wheel_speed is wheel speed RELATIVE to box
wheel_angle_anim = cumtrapz( ...
    t_anim, ...
    wheel_speed_anim);


%% ============================================================
% VISUAL DIMENSIONS
% =============================================================

boxSize = 0.40;      % side length of box

wheelR = 0.12;       % reaction wheel radius

% Distance from corner to center of square
a = boxSize / sqrt(2);


%% ============================================================
% BOX GEOMETRY
% =============================================================
%
% theta = 0:
%
%             /\
%            /  \
%           / O  \
%          /      \
%         /        \
%         \        /
%          \      /
%           \    /
%            \  /
%             *
%
%             ^
%           pivot
%
% Bottom corner is exactly at (0,0)

boxLocal = [ ...
     0,     0;
     a,     a;
     0,   2*a;
    -a,     a;
     0,     0];


% Reaction wheel is located at center of box

wheelCenterLocal = [0, a];


%% ============================================================
% CREATE FIGURE
% =============================================================

animationFigure = figure(20);
clf;
set(animationFigure, 'Color', 'white', 'Units', 'pixels', ...
    'Position', [100 100 960 720], 'Resize', 'off', ...
    'Name', 'Reaction Wheel Simulation', 'NumberTitle', 'off');

hold on;
axis equal;
grid on;
set(gca, 'Color', 'white', 'XColor', [0.08 0.18 0.20], ...
    'YColor', [0.08 0.18 0.20], 'GridColor', [0.45 0.55 0.55], ...
    'FontSize', 12);

xlim([-0.55 0.55]);
ylim([-0.10 0.75]);

xlabel('X');
ylabel('Y');


%% Ground

plot( ...
    [-1 1], ...
    [0 0], ...
    'k-', ...
    'LineWidth',2);


%% Title

titleHandle = title('', 'Color', [0.08 0.18 0.20], 'FontSize', 14);


%% ============================================================
% INITIAL BOX
% =============================================================

boxPlot = plot( ...
    boxLocal(:,1), ...
    boxLocal(:,2), ...
    'Color', [0.08 0.25 0.26], 'LineWidth',4);


%% ============================================================
% REACTION WHEEL
% =============================================================

circleAngle = linspace(0,2*pi,100);

wheelCircle = plot( ...
    wheelCenterLocal(1) + wheelR*cos(circleAngle), ...
    wheelCenterLocal(2) + wheelR*sin(circleAngle), ...
    'Color', [0.32 0.48 0.10], 'LineWidth',3);


%% ============================================================
% WHEEL SPOKES
% =============================================================

spoke1 = plot([0 0],[0 0],'Color',[0.32 0.48 0.10],'LineWidth',2);

spoke2 = plot([0 0],[0 0],'Color',[0.32 0.48 0.10],'LineWidth',2);

spoke3 = plot([0 0],[0 0],'Color',[0.32 0.48 0.10],'LineWidth',2);

spoke4 = plot([0 0],[0 0],'Color',[0.32 0.48 0.10],'LineWidth',2);

spokes = { ...
    spoke1, ...
    spoke2, ...
    spoke3, ...
    spoke4};


%% ============================================================
% PIVOT
% =============================================================

plot( ...
    0, ...
    0, ...
    'ko', ...
    'MarkerSize',10, ...
    'MarkerFaceColor','k');


%% ============================================================
% ANIMATION LOOP
% =============================================================

if exportVideo
    videoWriter = VideoWriter(videoFile, 'MPEG-4');
    videoWriter.FrameRate = fps;
    videoWriter.Quality = 95;
    open(videoWriter);
end

try
for k = 1:length(t_anim)

    %% Current simulation state

    th = theta_anim(k);

    phi = wheel_angle_anim(k);

    omega = wheel_speed_anim(k);


    %% Rotation matrix for box

    R = [ ...
        cos(th), -sin(th);
        sin(th),  cos(th)];


    %% --------------------------------------------------------
    % ROTATE BOX
    % ---------------------------------------------------------

    boxWorld = (R * boxLocal')';

    boxPlot.XData = boxWorld(:,1);

    boxPlot.YData = boxWorld(:,2);


    %% --------------------------------------------------------
    % REACTION WHEEL CENTER
    % ---------------------------------------------------------

    wc = R * wheelCenterLocal';


    %% Draw wheel circle

    wheelCircle.XData = ...
        wc(1) + wheelR*cos(circleAngle);

    wheelCircle.YData = ...
        wc(2) + wheelR*sin(circleAngle);


    %% --------------------------------------------------------
    % WHEEL ROTATION
    % ---------------------------------------------------------
    %
    % phi = wheel rotation relative to box
    %
    % th + phi = absolute wheel rotation

    wheelAbsoluteAngle = th + phi;


    %% Four spoke angles

    spokeAngles = ...
        wheelAbsoluteAngle + ...
        [0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2];


    %% Update spokes

    for j = 1:4

        sx = ...
            wc(1) + ...
            wheelR*cos(spokeAngles(j));

        sy = ...
            wc(2) + ...
            wheelR*sin(spokeAngles(j));


        spokes{j}.XData = ...
            [wc(1), sx];

        spokes{j}.YData = ...
            [wc(2), sy];

    end


    %% --------------------------------------------------------
    % TITLE
    % ---------------------------------------------------------

    titleHandle.String = sprintf( ...
        't = %.2f s    box = %.1f deg    wheel = %.0f RPM', ...
        t_anim(k), ...
        rad2deg(th), ...
        omega*60/(2*pi));


    %% --------------------------------------------------------
    % DRAW FRAME
    % ---------------------------------------------------------

    if exportVideo
        % Render every frame; video playback timing comes from FrameRate.
        drawnow;
        writeVideo(videoWriter, getframe(animationFigure));
    else
        drawnow limitrate;
        pause(1/fps);
    end

end
catch animationError
    if exportVideo
        close(videoWriter);
    end
    rethrow(animationError);
end

if exportVideo
    close(videoWriter);
    fprintf('Simulation video saved to: %s\n', videoFile);
end
